exposure: number of previous cesarean sections (5 groups)
cohort: 2460 patients who underwent cesarean delivery at a center in southeast Turkey between January 2012 and January 2014
finding: An increasing number of cesarean sections was associated with an increased risk of maternal complications, with four or more cesarean sections being a critical threshold.
mod_finding: This study examined maternal morbidity in relation to repeat cesarean deliveries, finding that the risk of complications increases with each subsequent cesarean section.
